subject: Online road rage & marked man
author: Lofty_1783
body:
Before I start either of these events, I usually set up a challenge to get everyone together. For example, jumping in the quarry/airfield/dead mans edge/on the beach, drifting in the stock car track... you get the idea. That way everyone is in a similar area at the start of the Road Rage/Marked Man and anyone who runs away to hide in a corner is usually the only one who doesn't score any points.
Another good game is to get everyone into the quarry or airfield and tell them not to leave the area. Then you do the entire marked man while everyone is in the quarry (or airfield). You've really got to be careful because any incorrect braking or turning and you're gone! As long as you get people up for the fun of it, it's always hilarious and infuriating at the same time.

subject: Road Rage and Marked Man
author: Abernyte
body:
Both of these events lack urgency in Paradise and a lot of that would be solved by starting everyone in the same spot.

For Road Rage I would also eliminate the checkpoint. With a single destination most players will be following the shortest route so you'd maximize the number of cars in the same area. I would think that would make it a lot more exciting.

A lot of marked man events end with no one scoring a takedown because everyone is so scatterred across the map. Others have at least one person camped out in a hiding spot. Starting everyone in a single spot would reduce the frequency of both these outcomes.
